integrity: A direct combinatorial sphere-plus-six-edges proof and an integral relative homology exact sequence; standalone exhaustive graph/automorphism verifier included. Potential unindexed equivalent literature remains.
scientific_limitations: One finite icosahedral graph; determines ordinary homotopy type and homology G-modules, not equivariant homotopy equivalence or unrelated Platonic graphs; no assertion of an integral splitting into individual complex three-dimensional irreducibles.
title: Integral icosahedral independence homology as an antipodal vertex lattice
